;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2020 Nova Scotia attacks]]
**A killing spree occurs in the small coastal town of [[Portapique]], near [[Truro, Nova Scotia]], [[Canada]]. At least 17 people are dead, including the perpetrator and a [[Royal Canadian Mounted Police]] officer, making it the deadliest [[list of massacres in Canada|rampage]] in [[Canadian history]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/nova-scotia/rcmp-weapon-lockdown-portapique-1.5537598 (CBC News)] [https://apnews.com/7c9a33ae52420e0ddbfb5275898a7e79 (Associated Press)]
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2019–20 Western Libya offensive]], [[Turkish military intervention in the Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Government of National Accord|GNA]] [[Libyan Armed Forces|forces]] advance on the key town of [[Tarhuna]] in the [[Murqub District]], capturing dozens of [[Khalifa Haftar]] loyalists and several vehicles after overrunning a [[Libyan National Army]] military camp. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/killed-libyas-gna-forces-approach-haftar-stronghold-200419094221149.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[April 2020 Katsina attacks]]
**Gunmen raid multiple villages in [[Nigeria]]'s [[Katsina State]], killing at least 47 people, according to police. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security/armed-bandits-kill-47-in-northwest-nigerias-katsina-state-police-idUKKBN2210Q8?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
**[[Warsaw]] commemorates the heroes of the [[Warsaw Ghetto Uprising]], but memorial observances were moved to the internet due to the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] crisis. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Virus-spread-scales-down-Warsaw-Ghetto-15211113.php (SFGate)]
* On [[Divine Mercy Sunday]], [[Pope Francis]] speaks at [[Santo Spirito in Sassia]] and warns about being struck by a worse virus of forgetting the poor and of “selfish indifference.” [https://cruxnow.com/vatican/2020/04/pope-warns-against-worse-virus-of-indifference-to-the-poor-after-pandemic/ (''Crux'')] [https://www.ncregister.com/daily-news/pope-francis-on-divine-mercy-sunday-beware-of-the-virus-of-selfish-indiffer (NC Register)] [https://www.americamagazine.org/faith/2020/04/19/divine-mercy-sunday-pope-francis-urges-countries-put-aside-selfish-indifference (''America'')]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Iranian Revolutionary Guards]] announces it has increased patrols of the [[Persian Gulf]] following a confrontation between [[Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|its Navy]] and the [[United States Navy|U.S.'s]] on Wednesday, and warns that "any error in calculation on [a foreign vessel's] part will receive a decisive response". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-usa-gulf/irans-revolutionary-guards-say-have-increased-gulf-patrols-idUSKBN2210FB?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[China–Vietnam relations]], [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Vietnam)|Vietnamese Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] condemns [[China]]'s decision yesterday to establish administrative districts in the disputed [[Paracel Islands|Paracel]] and [[Spratly Islands]], saying it violates [[Vietnam]]'s sovereignty. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-china-southchinasea/vietnam-protests-beijings-expansion-in-disputed-south-china-sea-idUSKBN2210M7?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Censorship in Turkey]]
**Turkey blocks access to the websites of [[Saudi Press Agency]] and [[Emirates News Agency]] in response to [[Saudi Arabia]] blocking access to Turkey's state-run [[Anadolu Agency]] a few days ago. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/turkey-blocks-saudi-emirati-state-news-websites-200419112800587.html (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Corruption in Israel]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
**Over 2,000 [[Israelis]] protest Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], accusing him of endangering democracy in the country and using the coronavirus crisis to escape prosecution on corruption charges. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/israelis-accuse-netanyahu-endangering-democracy-70233221 (ABC News)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
**Unrest breaks out in [[Paris]], [[Berlin]], and in [[Vladikavkaz]] as people oppose lockdowns. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/20/german-shops-open-angela-merkel-warns-second-wave-coronavirus (''The Guardian'')] [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-lockdown-sparks-riots-in-paris-11975809 (Sky News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Malian parliamentary election]]
**[[Mali]]ans head to the polls in a second round of voting to elect a new [[National Assembly (Mali)|National Assembly]]. The election has been mired in controversy over fears of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Mali|coronavirus]] spreading at [[polling station]]s, threats of Islamist violence, and the kidnapping of opposition politician [[Soumaïla Cissé]]. [https://www.voanews.com/africa/elections-continue-mali-despite-virus-violence-fears (Voice of America)]
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Presumptive nominee [[Joe Biden]] wins the mail-in [[Wyoming]] [[2020 Wyoming Democratic presidential caucuses|caucuses]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/biden-picks-up-more-delegates-with-wyoming-caucus-win-2020-04-19/ (CBS News)]
